agent-ui-react\n\n[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.6-blue.svg)](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/ChangeLog.md)\n[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/LICENSE)\n\nA React component library for building agent-based user interfaces. Provides production-ready components for conversational AI experiences, authentication, and template-driven data rendering — all built on [Fluent UI](https://react.fluentui.dev/) and the [AG-UI protocol](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol).\n\n---\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Features](#features)\n- [Installation](#installation)\n- [Quick Start](#quick-start)\n- [Components](#components)\n- [Dependencies](#dependencies)\n- [Browser Support](#browser-support)\n- [Release Notes](#release-notes)\n- [Contributing](#contributing)\n- [License](#license)\n\n---\n\n## Features\n\n- Conversational AI assistant with multi-agent support and AG-UI protocol streaming\n- Dynamic UI generation — assistant messages rendered as styled HTML via Azure OpenAI\n- Voice input with Web Speech API integration\n- Lazy message loading with `IntersectionObserver` for performant chat history\n- Resizable side panel with drag-to-resize and responsive default widths\n- Mobile responsive layout — fullscreen overlay on small screens, side panel on desktop\n- Starter prompt chips for guided onboarding\n- JWT-based authentication with role-to-permission mapping\n- JSON-driven template rendering with 8 built-in control types and data binding\n- Visual template designer with drag-and-drop, live preview, and JSON editing\n- Built on Microsoft Fluent UI for a consistent, accessible design system\n- Fully typed with TypeScript — ships with declaration files\n\n---\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\nnpm install agent-ui-react\n```\n\n---\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```tsx\nimport { AIAssistant, AuthProvider } from \"agent-ui-react\";\n\nfunction App() {\n  return (\n    <AuthProvider\n      config={{ apiBaseUrl: \"https://api.example.com\", appId: \"my-app\" }}\n      getAccessToken={getAccessToken}\n    >\n      <AIAssistant\n        config={{ apiBaseUrl: \"https://api.example.com\", appId: \"my-app\" }}\n        getAccessToken={getAccessToken}\n        userInfo={{ name: \"Jane\", email: \"jane@example.com\" }}\n        permissions={[\"chat\", \"templates\"]}\n        displayMode=\"Copilot\"\n        onClose={() => console.log(\"closed\")}\n      />\n    </AuthProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Description | Documentation |\n|-----------|-------------|---------------|\n| **AuthProvider** | Wraps your app to provide authenticated user info and role-based permissions via React Context. Decodes JWT tokens and fetches user roles from the API. | [AuthProvider Docs](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/AuthProvider.md) |\n| **AIAssistant** | Full-featured conversational AI chat UI with multi-agent support, conversation history, starter prompts, templates, and AG-UI protocol integration. | [AIAssistant Docs](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/AIAssistant.md) |\n| **TemplateRenderer** | Renders JSON-defined `ITemplate` objects against server data. Displays structured, data-bound UI cards with support for 8 control types and data binding. | [TemplateRenderer Docs](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/TemplateRenderer.md) |\n| **TemplateDesigner** | Visual drag-and-drop editor for creating and editing `ITemplate` JSON definitions. Includes property panel, live preview, JSON editing, and data source binding. | [TemplateDesigner Docs](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/TemplateDesigner.md) |\n\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\n### Runtime\n\n| Package | Description |\n|---------|-------------|\n| `@ag-ui/client` | AG-UI protocol client for agent communication |\n| `@ag-ui/core` | AG-UI protocol core types and utilities |\n| `@fluentui/react-components` | Microsoft Fluent UI React component library |\n| `react` | React library |\n| `react-dom` | React DOM renderer |\n| `react-router` | Declarative routing for React |\n\n---\n\n## Browser Support\n\n| Browser | Supported |\n|---------|-----------|\n| Chrome (latest) | Yes |\n| Edge (latest) | Yes |\n| Firefox (latest) | Yes |\n| Safari (latest) | Yes |\n\n---\n\n## Release Notes\n\nSee the full [version history and changelog](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/docs/ChangeLog.md).\n\n---\n\n## Contributing\n\nContributions are welcome! Here's how you can help:\n\n1. **Fork** the repository\n2. **Create** a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/my-feature`)\n3. **Commit** your changes (`git commit -m \"Add my feature\"`)\n4. **Push** to the branch (`git push origin feature/my-feature`)\n5. **Open** a Pull Request\n\nFor questions or feature requests, please [open an issue](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/issues) or [contact us](mailto:visit.chinmaya@gmail.com).\n\n---\n\n## Authors\n\nDeveloped and maintained by [Tech Trips](https://github.com/techtrips).\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nThis project is licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/techtrips/agent-ui/blob/main/agent-ui-react/LICENSE).\n\nCopyright © 2026 Tech Trips\n","readmeFilename":"README.md"}
